svg.title: The slopes of tan x are sec squared x
svg.desc: Top: y = tan x between its vertical asymptotes at x = minus pi/2 and pi/2 (dashed), with tangent lines at x = 0 (slope 1) and x = pi/4 (slope 2). Bottom, on the same scale: y = sec squared x, which is 1 at x = 0, 2 at x = pi/4, never less than 1, and grows without bound near the asymptotes. The derivative of tan x is sec squared x.
svg.text: slope of tan x is at least 1
